metadata.title: Unbounded normalized cofactor spectra for rank-two Gram matrices

affiliations.name: School of Computer Science and Engineering, South China University of Technology

metadata.description:
For every R > 0, there exists a finite complex rank-two correlation matrix A for which both lambda_max(C(A))/per(A) and lambda_max(Re C(A))/per(A) exceed R. Here C(A)_ij = A_ij per A(i|j), with row i and column j removed. Positive-definite correlation examples follow by continuity; they are not asserted to remain rank two. The theorem excludes every dimension-independent constant, without asserting a rate in the matrix order.

The record contains the four-page manuscript PDF, standalone TeX source, expanded analytic proof, source comparison, internal mathematical review and an optional n=200 Gaussian-integer certificate with two distinct exact integer checking algorithms. The analytic theorem does not depend on the finite certificate. This is separate from the companion sharp-asymptotic manuscript, from Drury's earlier R=1 cofactor counterexample and from Lieb's permanental-dominance conjecture.
